subject: biology

hotspots.label: Xylem tube
hotspots.description: A single long hollow tube of the xylem bundle that carries water and minerals upward.
hotspots.positionHint: One slender vertical tube within the bundle, highlighted with blue droplets inside.
hotspots.function: Carries water and minerals upward through the plant.

hotspots.label: Root entry
hotspots.description: The point at the root where water from the soil enters the xylem tubes.
hotspots.positionHint: The base of the stem slice where droplets enter from below.
hotspots.function: Where soil water first enters the xylem.

hotspots.label: Leaf end
hotspots.description: The end of the xylem route where the water reaches the leaves to be used.
hotspots.positionHint: The top opening of the tube where droplets reach the leaf portal.
hotspots.function: Delivers water to the leaves for photosynthesis.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean stylized diorama - a vertical stem slice with a bundle of pale blue-tinged tubes, muted greens and creams, no glow. Strong color reserved for the hotspot dots and water droplets.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Water droplets are simple transparent spheres, not emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a vertical slice of plant stem standing tall, with a bundle of long hollow xylem tubes running from bottom to top. Blue water droplets rise up a single tube from a root entry at the base to a leaf portal at the top. Named nodes: StemSlice, XylemBundle, SingleTube, RootEntry, LeafPortal, WaterDrops. Budget 10-14k.
